invariants: A source capability must already be VERIFIED with provenance before it can seed a transfer hypothesis.
A target need must be evidenced; graph absence is uncertainty, not proof of missing capability.
Transfer proposals begin as hypotheses and cannot add REUSED_BY or GENERATED_VALUE_FOR graph edges.
Actual code or asset reuse requires rights/license verification and applicable Step 16 target-repository onboarding.
Target implementation cannot bypass factory, repair, governance or human ACT gates.
Transfer success requires a measurable target metric and independently VERIFIED target outcome.
VERIFIED_NO_VALUE is useful negative knowledge and must not be rewritten as success.
INCONCLUSIVE remains inconclusive; silence or missing evidence is not failure or success.
Only VERIFIED_EFFECTIVE outcomes with zero authority violations may generate success-edge candidates.
Generated success edges are proposals for graph ingestion, not automatic graph mutation.
